parameters.note: Sausal Creek and its tributaries, an urban Oakland Hills creek that flows through Dimond Canyon and Dimond Park to the Oakland Estuary, are closed to all fishing all year.

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license. (Note: this water is closed to all fishing all year, so no take is permitted regardless of license status.)
